status: frozen after a July 1 acquisition/schema smoke test and before bulk acquisition, target compilation, model fitting, or July-August scoring
pre_freeze_access: The downloader read first records from July 1 training-period archives only to validate container/schema/timestamp shape. No validation or development-forward archive payload, compiled target, or score was inspected.
study_name: CHMT-Q Tiny BTC-USDT July-August 2026 development pilot
purpose: Test whether model compression preserves five-target footprint quantile forecasting.
claim_boundary: Development evidence only. No executable-return, action, edge, profitability, promotion, or confirmatory claim is permitted.

partitions.reserved: 2026-08-05 onward is outside this experiment and may not be appended after scoring.

training.presence_loss_rule: Set weight to zero if either class is below 1% in any training cell; do not infer the rule from validation or test.

baselines: train-only hour-of-day quantiles shrunk to the global marginal
quantile ridge or DLinear on causal summary features
test_open_rule: Generate and score development-forward predictions once, after every seed and baseline has a validation-selected frozen checkpoint. Logged acquisition and integrity checks may inspect raw records before then, so this partition is not described as sealed, untouched, or unaccessed.
required_secondary_metrics: horizon-5 total-POC Pearson, Spearman, and sign MCC
presence Brier and log loss only when both classes are evaluable
hard_gates: 71 of 71 required source archives pass downloader size, archive, first-record schema/timestamp, and SHA-256 checks

the compiler fully streams every archive, filters the exact UTC half-open interval, deduplicates trade overlap, validates all event timestamps/order and L2 snapshot continuity, and records per-day coverage
